title: AdConversionContextDocument
description: Server-only ad-click context saved when a paid public checkout is prepared, so a later server conversion can be matched to the ad that caused it (docs/ads_conversion_spec.md, Server delivery). The first context for a checkout is kept; retries never replace it. Holds no contact details. Deleted with the account and at expiresAt.

subjectKind.description: The authoritative record this context belongs to. A paid public checkout is the only kind today.

subjectId.description: The guestPayments document ID of the public checkout.

clientIpAddress.description: The caller's IP address as seen by the checkout callable, for Meta and Google matching. Null when it was unavailable or malformed.

expiresAt.description: 90 days after createdAt, the longest click-through window either platform accepts.
